errors.evidence: The description states the x-axis tick interval is 0.1, which is true for most of the axis, but it overgeneralizes as the final interval is from 0.5 to 0.585, which is not 0.1.
The description identifies the 'Teacher' line as a red dashed line with circular markers. The figure shows it as a red solid line with star-shaped markers.
The description states the 'Teacher' line starts at an F1 value of approximately 72.2. The actual value shown in the plot is visibly lower, at approximately 71.8.
The description identifies the 'Self-Training' line as a blue dashed line. The figure shows it is a blue solid line.
The description identifies the 'PST' line as a green dashed line. The figure shows it is a green solid line.
The description states the 'PST' line starts at an F1 value of approximately 72.2. The actual value shown in the plot is visibly lower, at approximately 72.0.
